struct JadedConfig
    n_layers::Int
    d_model::Int
    n_heads::Int
    d_ff::Int
    dropout::Float32
    max_seq_len::Int
    n_atom_types::Int
    n_residue_types::Int
    use_mixed_precision::Bool
    gradient_accumulation_steps::Int
end

function default_config()
    return JadedConfig(
        64,
        2048,
        32,
        8192,
        0.1f0,
        4096,
        37,
        20,
        true,
        4
    )
end

struct MultiHeadAttention
    W_q::Dense
    W_k::Dense
    W_v::Dense
    W_o::Dense
    n_heads::Int
    d_k::Int
    dropout::Dropout
end

function MultiHeadAttention(d_model::Int, n_heads::Int, dropout::Float32=0.1f0)
    d_k = d_model ÷ n_heads
    return MultiHeadAttention(
        Dense(d_model, d_model),
        Dense(d_model, d_model),
        Dense(d_model, d_model),
        Dense(d_model, d_model),
        n_heads,
        d_k,
        Dropout(dropout)
    )
end

Flux.@functor MultiHeadAttention

function (m::MultiHeadAttention)(Q, K, V, mask=nothing)
    batch_size = size(Q, 3)
    Q_proj = m.W_q(Q)
    K_proj = m.W_k(K)
    V_proj = m.W_v(V)
    Q_heads = reshape(Q_proj, :, m.n_heads, m.d_k, batch_size)
    K_heads = reshape(K_proj, :, m.n_heads, m.d_k, batch_size)
    V_heads = reshape(V_proj, :, m.n_heads, m.d_k, batch_size)
    scores = NNlib.batched_mul(permutedims(Q_heads, (3, 1, 2, 4)), permutedims(K_heads, (3, 1, 2, 4)))
    scores = scores ./ sqrt(Float32(m.d_k))
    if !isnothing(mask)
        scores = scores .+ mask
    end
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=2)
    attn_weights = m.dropout(attn_weights)
    context = NNlib.batched_mul(attn_weights, permutedims(V_heads, (3, 1, 2, 4)))
    context = permutedims(context, (2, 3, 1, 4))
    context = reshape(context, :, m.n_heads * m.d_k, batch_size)
    output = m.W_o(context)
    return output
end

struct TransformerBlock
    self_attn::MultiHeadAttention
    cross_attn::MultiHeadAttention
    ffn::Chain
    norm1::LayerNorm
    norm2::LayerNorm
    norm3::LayerNorm
    dropout::Dropout
end

function TransformerBlock(d_model::Int, n_heads::Int, d_ff::Int, dropout::Float32=0.1f0)
    return TransformerBlock(
        MultiHeadAttention(d_model, n_heads, dropout),
        MultiHeadAttention(d_model, n_heads, dropout),
        Chain(
            Dense(d_model, d_ff, gelu),
            Dropout(dropout),
            Dense(d_ff, d_model)
        ),
        LayerNorm(d_model),
        LayerNorm(d_model),
        LayerNorm(d_model),
        Dropout(dropout)
    )
end

Flux.@functor TransformerBlock

function (m::TransformerBlock)(x, encoder_output, src_mask=nothing, tgt_mask=nothing)
    attn_output = m.self_attn(x, x, x, tgt_mask)
    x = m.norm1(x .+ m.dropout(attn_output))
    cross_attn_output = m.cross_attn(x, encoder_output, encoder_output, src_mask)
    x = m.norm2(x .+ m.dropout(cross_attn_output))
    ffn_output = m.ffn(x)
    x = m.norm3(x .+ m.dropout(ffn_output))
    return x
end

struct JadedModel
    config::JadedConfig
    residue_embedding::Embedding
    position_encoding::CuArray{Float32, 3}
    encoder_blocks::Vector{TransformerBlock}
    decoder_blocks::Vector{TransformerBlock}
    output_projection::Dense
end

function JadedModel(config::JadedConfig)
    position_encoding = create_sinusoidal_encoding(config.max_seq_len, config.d_model) |> gpu
    encoder_blocks = [TransformerBlock(config.d_model, config.n_heads, config.d_ff, config.dropout) for _ in 1:config.n_layers]
    decoder_blocks = [TransformerBlock(config.d_model, config.n_heads, config.d_ff, config.dropout) for _ in 1:config.n_layers]
    return JadedModel(
        config,
        Embedding(config.n_residue_types, config.d_model),
        position_encoding,
        encoder_blocks,
        decoder_blocks,
        Dense(config.d_model, config.n_atom_types * 3)
    )
end

Flux.@functor JadedModel

function create_sinusoidal_encoding(max_len::Int, d_model::Int)
    pe = zeros(Float32, max_len, d_model, 1)
    position = Float32.(0:max_len-1)
    div_term = exp.(Float32.(0:2:d_model-1) .* (-log(10000.0f0) / d_model))
    pe[:, 1:2:end, 1] = sin.(position * div_term')
    pe[:, 2:2:end, 1] = cos.(position * div_term')
    return pe
end

function (m::JadedModel)(seq, mask=nothing)
    x = m.residue_embedding(seq)
    seq_len = size(x, 1)
    x = x .+ m.position_encoding[1:seq_len, :, :]
    for block in m.encoder_blocks
        x = block(x, x, mask, mask)
    end
    encoder_output = x
    decoder_input = CUDA.zeros(Float32, seq_len, m.config.d_model, size(x, 3))
    for block in m.decoder_blocks
        decoder_input = block(decoder_input, encoder_output, mask, mask)
    end
    output = m.output_projection(decoder_input)
    output = reshape(output, seq_len, m.config.n_atom_types, 3, size(output, 3))
    return output
end

struct ProteinDataset
    sequences::Vector{Vector{Int}}
    structures::Vector{CuArray{Float32, 3}}
    masks::Vector{Vector{Bool}}
end

const AA_TO_INT = Dict(
    'A' => 1, 'R' => 2, 'N' => 3, 'D' => 4, 'C' => 5,
    'Q' => 6, 'E' => 7, 'G' => 8, 'H' => 9, 'I' => 10,
    'L' => 11, 'K' => 12, 'M' => 13, 'F' => 14, 'P' => 15,
    'S' => 16, 'T' => 17, 'W' => 18, 'Y' => 19, 'V' => 20
)

const AA3_TO_AA1 = Dict(
    "ALA" => 'A', "ARG" => 'R', "ASN" => 'N', "ASP" => 'D', "CYS" => 'C',
    "GLN" => 'Q', "GLU" => 'E', "GLY" => 'G', "HIS" => 'H', "ILE" => 'I',
    "LEU" => 'L', "LYS" => 'K', "MET" => 'M', "PHE" => 'F', "PRO" => 'P',
    "SER" => 'S', "THR" => 'T', "TRP" => 'W', "TYR" => 'Y', "VAL" => 'V'
)

const ATOM_ORDER = ["N", "CA", "C", "O", "CB", "CG", "CG1", "CG2", "CD", "CD1", "CD2", 
                    "CE", "CE1", "CE2", "CE3", "CZ", "CZ2", "CZ3", "CH2", "NE", "NE1", 
                    "NE2", "NH1", "NH2", "ND1", "ND2", "OE1", "OE2", "OG", "OG1", "OH",
                    "OD1", "OD2", "SD", "SG", "SE", "NZ"]

function parse_cif_file(filepath::String)
    if !isfile(filepath)
        throw(ErrorException(string("File not found: ", filepath)))
    end
    
    content = read(filepath, String)
    lines = splitlines(content)
    
    atom_data = Dict{String, Vector{String}}()
    in_atom_loop = false
    loop_keys = String[]
    
    for line in lines
        stripped = strip(line)
        if isempty(stripped) || startswith(stripped, "#")
            continue
        end
        
        if startswith(stripped, "loop_")
            in_atom_loop = true
            empty!(loop_keys)
            continue
        end
        
        if in_atom_loop
            if startswith(stripped, "_atom_site.")
                key = replace(stripped, "_atom_site." => "")
                push!(loop_keys, key)
                atom_data[key] = String[]
            elseif !startswith(stripped, "_")
                tokens = split(stripped)
                if length(tokens) >= length(loop_keys)
                    for (i, key) in enumerate(loop_keys)
                        push!(atom_data[key], tokens[i])
                    end
                end
            else
                in_atom_loop = false
            end
        end
    end
    
    if !haskey(atom_data, "label_comp_id") || !haskey(atom_data, "Cartn_x")
        throw(ErrorException("Missing required atom_site fields in CIF file"))
    end
    
    residue_atoms = Dict{Int, Dict{String, Tuple{Float32, Float32, Float32}}}()
    residue_comp_ids = Dict{Int, String}()
    
    n_atoms = length(atom_data["label_comp_id"])
    
    for i in 1:n_atoms
        comp_id = atom_data["label_comp_id"][i]
        atom_name = haskey(atom_data, "label_atom_id") ? atom_data["label_atom_id"][i] : ""
        
        seq_id_str = haskey(atom_data, "label_seq_id") ? atom_data["label_seq_id"][i] : "0"
        seq_id = tryparse(Int, seq_id_str)
        if isnothing(seq_id)
            continue
        end
        
        x = parse(Float32, atom_data["Cartn_x"][i])
        y = parse(Float32, atom_data["Cartn_y"][i])
        z = parse(Float32, atom_data["Cartn_z"][i])
        
        if !haskey(residue_atoms, seq_id)
            residue_atoms[seq_id] = Dict{String, Tuple{Float32, Float32, Float32}}()
            residue_comp_ids[seq_id] = comp_id
        end
        
        residue_atoms[seq_id][atom_name] = (x, y, z)
    end
    
    sorted_residues = sort(collect(keys(residue_atoms)))
    
    if isempty(sorted_residues)
        throw(ErrorException("No valid residues found in structure"))
    end
    
    seq = Int[]
    coords_list = Vector{Float32}[]
    mask = Bool[]
    
    for res_id in sorted_residues
        comp_id = residue_comp_ids[res_id]
        aa1 = get(AA3_TO_AA1, comp_id, 'X')
        aa_int = get(AA_TO_INT, aa1, 1)
        
        push!(seq, aa_int)
        
        residue_coords = zeros(Float32, 37, 3)
        atoms_found = 0
        
        for (atom_idx, atom_name) in enumerate(ATOM_ORDER)
            if haskey(residue_atoms[res_id], atom_name)
                x, y, z = residue_atoms[res_id][atom_name]
                residue_coords[atom_idx, 1] = x
                residue_coords[atom_idx, 2] = y
                residue_coords[atom_idx, 3] = z
                atoms_found += 1
            end
        end
        
        push!(coords_list, vec(residue_coords))
        push!(mask, atoms_found >= 3)
    end
    
    coords_matrix = zeros(Float32, length(seq), 37, 3)
    for (i, coord_vec) in enumerate(coords_list)
        coords_matrix[i, :, :] = reshape(coord_vec, 37, 3)
    end
    
    return seq, coords_matrix, mask
end

function parse_pdb_file(filepath::String)
    if !isfile(filepath)
        throw(ErrorException(string("File not found: ", filepath)))
    end
    
    lines = readlines(filepath)
    
    residue_atoms = Dict{Tuple{Int, Char}, Dict{String, Tuple{Float32, Float32, Float32}}}()
    residue_comp_ids = Dict{Tuple{Int, Char}, String}()
    
    for line in lines
        if !startswith(line, "ATOM  ") && !startswith(line, "HETATM")
            continue
        end
        
        if length(line) < 54
            continue
        end
        
        atom_name = strip(line[13:16])
        res_name = strip(line[18:20])
        chain_id = length(line) >= 22 ? line[22] : 'A'
        
        res_seq_str = strip(line[23:26])
        res_seq = tryparse(Int, res_seq_str)
        if isnothing(res_seq)
            continue
        end
        
        x = parse(Float32, strip(line[31:38]))
        y = parse(Float32, strip(line[39:46]))
        z = parse(Float32, strip(line[47:54]))
        
        res_key = (res_seq, chain_id)
        
        if !haskey(residue_atoms, res_key)
            residue_atoms[res_key] = Dict{String, Tuple{Float32, Float32, Float32}}()
            residue_comp_ids[res_key] = res_name
        end
        
        residue_atoms[res_key][atom_name] = (x, y, z)
    end
    
    sorted_residues = sort(collect(keys(residue_atoms)))
    
    if isempty(sorted_residues)
        throw(ErrorException("No valid residues found in PDB structure"))
    end
    
    seq = Int[]
    coords_list = Vector{Float32}[]
    mask = Bool[]
    
    for res_key in sorted_residues
        comp_id = residue_comp_ids[res_key]
        aa1 = get(AA3_TO_AA1, comp_id, 'X')
        aa_int = get(AA_TO_INT, aa1, 1)
        
        push!(seq, aa_int)
        
        residue_coords = zeros(Float32, 37, 3)
        atoms_found = 0
        
        for (atom_idx, atom_name) in enumerate(ATOM_ORDER)
            if haskey(residue_atoms[res_key], atom_name)
                x, y, z = residue_atoms[res_key][atom_name]
                residue_coords[atom_idx, 1] = x
                residue_coords[atom_idx, 2] = y
                residue_coords[atom_idx, 3] = z
                atoms_found += 1
            end
        end
        
        push!(coords_list, vec(residue_coords))
        push!(mask, atoms_found >= 3)
    end
    
    coords_matrix = zeros(Float32, length(seq), 37, 3)
    for (i, coord_vec) in enumerate(coords_list)
        coords_matrix[i, :, :] = reshape(coord_vec, 37, 3)
    end
    
    return seq, coords_matrix, mask
end

function parse_structure_file(filepath::String)
    try
        if endswith(filepath, ".cif")
            return parse_cif_file(filepath)
        elseif endswith(filepath, ".pdb")
            return parse_pdb_file(filepath)
        else
            throw(ErrorException(string("Unsupported file format: ", filepath)))
        end
    catch e
        println("Error parsing ", filepath, ": ", e)
        rethrow(e)
    end
end

function load_alphafold_structures(data_dir::String, max_samples::Int=200000)
    println("Loading AlphaFold structures from: ", data_dir)
    sequences = Vector{Vector{Int}}()
    structures = Vector{CuArray{Float32, 3}}()
    masks = Vector{Vector{Bool}}()
    file_count = 0
    
    for (root, dirs, files) in walkdir(data_dir)
        for file in files
            if endswith(file, ".cif") || endswith(file, ".pdb")
                file_count += 1
                if file_count > max_samples
                    break
                end
                try
                    filepath = joinpath(root, file)
                    seq, coords, mask = parse_structure_file(filepath)
                    if length(seq) > 0 && length(seq) <= 4096
                        push!(sequences, seq)
                        push!(structures, CuArray(coords))
                        push!(masks, mask)
                    end
                catch e
                    println("Failed to parse ", file, ": ", e)
                end
            end
        end
        if file_count > max_samples
            break
        end
    end
    
    println("Loaded ", length(sequences), " structures")
    return ProteinDataset(sequences, structures, masks)
end

function create_batch(dataset::ProteinDataset, indices::Vector{Int}, max_len::Int)
    batch_size = length(indices)
    sequences = zeros(Int32, max_len, batch_size)
    structures = CUDA.zeros(Float32, max_len, 37, 3, batch_size)
    masks = zeros(Bool, max_len, batch_size)
    
    for (i, idx) in enumerate(indices)
        seq_len = length(dataset.sequences[idx])
        sequences[1:seq_len, i] = dataset.sequences[idx]
        structures[1:seq_len, :, :, i] = Array(dataset.structures[idx])
        masks[1:seq_len, i] = dataset.masks[idx]
    end
    
    return CuArray(sequences), structures, CuArray(masks)
end

function structure_loss(pred_coords, true_coords, mask)
    diff = pred_coords .- true_coords
    sq_diff = sum(diff .^ 2, dims=3)
    rmsd = sqrt.(sq_diff)
    mask4 = reshape(mask, size(mask, 1), 1, 1, size(mask, 2))
    masked_rmsd = rmsd .* mask4
    loss = sum(masked_rmsd) / sum(mask)
    return loss
end

function save_checkpoint(model, opt_state, epoch::Int, batch_idx::Int, loss::Float32, checkpoint_dir::String, is_best::Bool=false)
    model_cpu = model |> cpu
    checkpoint_data = Dict(
        "model" => model_cpu,
        "epoch" => epoch,
        "batch" => batch_idx,
        "loss" => loss,
        "timestamp" => now()
    )
    checkpoint_path = joinpath(checkpoint_dir, string("jaded_epoch_", epoch, "_batch_", batch_idx, ".bson"))
    BSON.@save checkpoint_path checkpoint_data
    println("Checkpoint saved: ", checkpoint_path, " (loss: ", loss, ")")
    
    if is_best
        best_path = joinpath(checkpoint_dir, "jaded_best.bson")
        BSON.@save best_path checkpoint_data
        println("Best checkpoint saved: ", best_path)
    end
    
    return checkpoint_path
end

function train_epoch!(model, dataset, opt_state, batch_size::Int, epoch::Int, checkpoint_dir::String, config::JadedConfig)
    n_samples = length(dataset.sequences)
    n_batches = div(n_samples, batch_size)
    total_loss = 0.0f0
    progress = Progress(n_batches, desc=string("Epoch ", epoch))
    
    for batch_idx in 1:n_batches
        start_idx = (batch_idx - 1) * batch_size + 1
        end_idx = min(batch_idx * batch_size, n_samples)
        indices = collect(start_idx:end_idx)
        sequences, structures, masks = create_batch(dataset, indices, 1024)
        
        ps = Flux.params(model)
        loss, grads = Flux.withgradient(ps) do
            pred_coords = model(sequences, masks)
            structure_loss(pred_coords, structures, masks)
        end
        
        Flux.update!(opt_state, ps, grads)
        total_loss += loss
        ProgressMeter.next!(progress, showvalues=[(:loss, loss), (:avg_loss, total_loss / batch_idx)])
        
        if batch_idx % 50 == 0
            intermediate_loss = total_loss / batch_idx
            save_checkpoint(model, opt_state, epoch, batch_idx, intermediate_loss, checkpoint_dir, false)
        end
        
        CUDA.reclaim()
    end
    
    avg_loss = total_loss / n_batches
    return avg_loss
end

function train_jaded(data_dir::String, epochs::Int, batch_size::Int, lr::Float32, checkpoint_dir::String)
    println("="^80)
    println("Jaded Protein Structure Prediction - 8x B200 GPU Training")

    dataset = load_alphafold_structures(data_dir, 200000)
    opt_state = Flux.setup(Adam(lr), model)

        is_best = avg_loss < best_loss

        end

    end

    final_path = joinpath(checkpoint_dir, "jaded_final.bson")

    )
    BSON.@save final_path checkpoint_data
    println("Final model saved to ", final_path)
